summary: Frontend-only Playwright e2e testing of PharmaFoil Industries marketing site. Verified all 14 routes load, navbar utility bar + mobile menu, product filtering/search/detail, RFQ 4-step flow with step validation gating and reference number generation, Contact form with success toast, Careers accordion. No console errors. All critical flows functional.
action_items: Minor naming inconsistency: Review request mentions form testid 'contact-email' but actual Contact.jsx uses 'contact-email-input' for the form input (because 'contact-email' is already used on the mailto <a> link in the contact info section). Same pattern: 'contact-phone' (mailto link) vs 'contact-phone-input' (form field). Either rename the mailto links to '*-link' so the inputs can claim the primary testid, or document the naming convention. Not a functional bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Sticky filter bar on /products uses top-[73px] lg:top-[97px] hard-coded offsets - tightly coupled to navbar height. Refactor with CSS variable.
RFQ submit() does not reset form state; if user navigates back from /rfq success screen they re-enter a fresh state only because component remounts via routing - acceptable but worth noting.
No 404 NotFound route in App.js - unknown paths render Layout with empty Outlet. Consider adding a catch-all <Route path='*' element={<NotFound />}>.
All forms simulate submission client-side only (mocked APIs per request) - acceptable for this frontend-only build.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 routes navigable. RFQ flow: step1 requires name+email+company, step2 requires product, step3 requires annualVolume+market. After submit a PF-RFQ-XXXXXX reference is shown. Contact form input testids are contact-name, contact-email-input, contact-phone-input, contact-message, contact-submit (NOT contact-email/contact-phone which are mailto links). Products page has 9 cards with testid pattern products-card-{slug}. Filter testids: filter-all, filter-primary-packaging, etc. Mobile menu opens with mobile-menu-toggle.
